description: Red Raptor Replacement: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You bring me your old raptor, I give you new one with freshly sharpened claws! The new raptor will be just as fast as your old one, but with a new look to him. You can look at the swift raptors here to see what you will have to choose from.
